lines.rookie:
Seoul is very old.
Its story is full of secrets.
lines.junior:
Seoul is very, very old.
Its history hides many secrets.
lines.master:
Seoul is ancient.
Its history is woven with secrets.

lines.rookie: A wet note waits by a turtle ship.
lines.junior: A damp note is waiting beside a turtle ship.
lines.master: A rain-soaked note lies beside a turtle ship.

lines.rookie: A lifting machine will not lift.
lines.junior: A lifting machine refuses to lift.
lines.master: A lifting machine stubbornly refuses to lift.

lines.rookie: Logs for the palace go missing.
lines.junior: Logs meant for the palace disappear.
lines.master: Timber bound for the palace vanishes.

lines.rookie: And the palace lights go dark.
lines.junior: Then the palace lights go out.
lines.master: And then the palace lamps fall dark.
They appear to be unrelated cases.

lines.rookie:
But a good detective
puts the pieces together.
lines.junior:
But a good detective
fits the pieces together.
lines.master:
Yet a fine detective
joins every piece together.

lines.junior: Who is writing all these notes?
lines.master: Who goes on writing these notes?

lines.rookie:
Every note has
the same small water drop.
lines.junior:
Each note carries
the same small water drop.
lines.master:
Every note bears
the same tiny water drop.

lines.rookie:
Your first case starts
in old Hanyang.
lines.junior:
Your first case begins
in old Hanyang.
lines.master:
Your first case awaits
in old Hanyang.

lines.rookie: Bun-i's first note lies under all the others.
lines.junior: Bun-i's first note rests beneath all the rest.
lines.master: Beneath every other note rests Bun-i's first.

lines.rookie: The letters she learned in 1446 are read freely again.
lines.junior: People read the letters she learned in 1446 freely once more.
lines.master: Once again, the letters she learned in 1446 may be read freely.

lines.rookie: Seoul keeps its story in its letters.
lines.junior: Seoul holds its story in its letters.
lines.master: Seoul preserves its story within its letters.

lines.rookie: This time, you read it note by note.
lines.junior: This time, you have read it one note at a time.
lines.master: This time, you have pieced it together note by note.
